headlines.title: China’s debt ratio dips as households cut borrowing and firms slash investment: report
headlines.summary:
China’s debt-to-GDP ratio fell in the second quarter for the first time since 2022, even as the government kept borrowing while households and private companies pulled back under the weight of falling home prices, sluggish income growth and shrinking profit margins, according to a new report.
The ratio slipped 1.1 percentage points to 308.2 per cent, the National Institution for Finance and Development (NIFD), a Beijing-based think tank, said in a quarterly report on Thursday.
The ratio compares...
headlines.title_zh: 中国债务比率回落，家庭减少借贷、企业削减投资：报告
headlines.summary_zh: 最新报告显示，尽管政府持续借贷，但家庭和企业因房价下跌、收入增长乏力及利润空间收窄而减少借贷，中国第二季度债务与国内生产总值之比自2022年以来首次下降。该比率下降1.1个百分点，至308.2%。

headlines.summary_zh: 北京承诺在今年剩余时间加大宏观政策支持力度并增强资本市场韧性，在近期经济活动放缓及全球市场波动加剧之际，发出稳定增长的信号。在由习近平领导的中共中央政治局21人会议结束后，这一信号得以释放。

headlines.title: 国金证券：监管层面释放两地互联互通政策红利 维持证券行业买入评级
headlines.summary: 国金证券发布研报称，监管层面持续释放互联互通的政策红利，将提高两地资本市场活跃度、丰富产品供给、提升中国资产的全球配置价值。香港交易所以及提供跨境融资、投资端服务的优质券商有望在长期受益。当前证券板块PB、PE估值为1.2x/16x倍，多家券商发布中期业绩预增公告，维持低估值、高业绩增速的证券行业的“买入”评级。

headlines.title_en: Sinolink Securities: Regulatory level releases cross-border connectivity policy dividends, maintains buy rating for securities industry
headlines.summary_en: Sinolink Securities research report stated that regulators continue to release policy benefits for cross-market connectivity, which will boost activity in both capital markets, enrich product supply, and enhance the global allocation value of Chinese assets. Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing, as well as quality brokers providing cross-border financing and investment services, are expected to benefit long-term. The current securities sector PB and PE valuations are 1.2x and 16x. Multiple brokers have issued interim earnings pre-increases, maintaining a 'Buy' rating on the securities industry with low valuations and high earnings growth.

headlines.summary: 江南新材公告，公司2026年度向特定对象发行A股股票预案已获董事会审议通过。本次发行对象为不超过35名特定投资者，发行价格不低于定价基准日前20个交易日公司股票交易均价的80%，发行数量未超过发行前总股本的30%。募集资金总额不超过16亿元（含本数），扣除发行费用后拟用于高纯电子级氧化铜粉建设项目（拟使用74,462.00万元）及液冷散热模组及配件建设项目（拟使用85,538.00万元）。本次发行尚需股东会审议通过、上交所审核通过及中国证监会同意注册。

headlines.title_en: Jiangnan New Materials: Plans private placement to raise up to 1.6 billion yuan for high-purity electronic-grade copper oxide powder and other projects
headlines.summary_en: Jiangnan New Material announced that its plan to issue A-shares to specific investors in 2026 has been approved by the board of directors. The issuance will target no more than 35 specific investors, with an issue price no lower than 80% of the average trading price of the company's shares over the 20 trading days prior to the pricing benchmark date, and the issuance amount will not exceed 30% of the total share capital before issuance. Total funds raised will not exceed RMB 1.6 billion (inclusive), to be used after deducting issuance expenses for the high-purity electronic-grade copper oxide powder construction project (RMB 744.62 million) and the liquid cooling散热 module and accessory construction project (RMB 855.38 million). The issuance still requires shareholder approval, Shanghai Stock Exchange review, and CSRC registration.

headlines.title: 花旗：日本捍卫日元不必抛售逾1.1万亿美元的美债持仓
headlines.summary: 花旗集团表示，日本在捍卫日元时不必抛售逾1.1万亿美元的美国公债持仓，即使其可动用的短期债券持有部位已所剩不多，仍有其他工具可供运用。以Jason Williams为首的策略师表示，日本当局可以动用美联储的“海外和国际货币管理当局回购交易安排”(FIMA Repo Facility)。该机制允许海外央行以持有的美国公债作为抵押，向美联储取得美元流动性，无须出售公债筹措现金。花旗指出，日本还可以动用存放在外国央行的1,600亿美元存款，其中大部分可能存放在美联储相关机构中，或使用欧元资产购买日元。

headlines.title_en: Citi: Japan need not sell over $1.1 trillion in US Treasury holdings to defend the yen
headlines.summary_en: Citigroup said Japan does not need to sell its over $1.1 trillion U.S. Treasury holdings to defend the yen, even with limited short-term bond positions left, as other tools remain available. Strategists led by Jason Williams noted Japanese authorities can use the Federal Reserve's Foreign and International Monetary Authorities Repo Facility, which allows overseas central banks to borrow dollar liquidity using U.S. Treasury holdings as collateral without selling them. Citigroup added Japan can also tap $160 billion in deposits held at foreign central banks, mostly possibly at Fed-related institutions, or use euro assets to buy yen.

headlines.title: 铜价突破1.4万美元大关，美国进口潮收紧全球供应
headlines.summary: 由于交易员密切关注美国境内不断增加的铜库存，以及美国总统特朗普预计将就进口关税作出决定，LME三个月期铜自6月3日以来首次突破14,000美元/吨。根据IHS Markit的航运数据，自2014年开始记录以来，今年7月抵达美国港口的铜超过20万吨，创下单月最高纪录。这进一步加剧了美国仓库和港口的铜库存积压，并导致世界其他地区买家的铜供应紧张。尽管精炼铜关税计划存在不确定性，但美国铜的流入速度仍在加快。美国商务部原定于6月30日前提出建议，但目前尚未公布决定。美国铜价仍高于LME铜价，跨市场套利交易依然具有盈利空间。

headlines.title_en: Copper price breaks $14,000 per ton, US import wave tightens global supply
headlines.summary_en: As traders closely monitor rising copper inventories in the U.S. and President Trump's expected decision on import tariffs, LME three-month copper broke above $14,000/ton for the first time since June 3. According to IHS Markit shipping data, over 200,000 tons of copper arrived at U.S. ports in July, the highest monthly record since tracking began in 2014. This has exacerbated inventory backlogs at U.S. warehouses and ports, tightening supply for buyers elsewhere. Despite uncertainty over refined copper tariff plans, inflows to the U.S. are accelerating. The U.S. Commerce Department was due to make recommendations by June 30 but has yet to announce a decision. U.S. copper prices remain above LME levels, keeping cross-market arbitrage profitable.

headlines.title_en: A-share close: ChiNext Index surges 5.64% on heavy volume, computing hardware stocks rebound collectively
headlines.summary_en: 1. The market rebounded throughout the day, with the ChiNext Index leading gains strongly. CPO, PCB, and other computing power hardware sectors surged, with multiple stocks like Gocoo Technology, Cambridge Industries, WUS Printed Circuit, and Shennan Circuits hitting limit-up. Semiconductor chip stocks rallied, with Harmoni Semiconductors and Jinhai Tong hitting limit-up. Computing power leasing concept rose, with Hangzhou Xingyun, Hongjing Technology, and Qingcloud all up 20% limit. Innovative drug stocks gained, with WuXi AppTec and Harsun hitting limit-up. On the downside, the banking sector fell against the trend, with the four major banks (ICBC, ABC, BOC, CCB) each falling over 3%. Advancers outnumbered decliners, with over 3,600 stocks rising across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets, and turnover at RMB 2.23 trillion. At close, the Shanghai Composite rose 0.33%, Shenzhen Component rose 3.25%, and ChiNext rose 5.64%. 2. By sector, CPO, PCB, semiconductor chips, and computing power leasing led gains, while banking, insurance, auto manufacturing, and baijiu declined.

headlines.title: 工信部：对于L3级自动驾驶系统应具备驾驶人接管能力监测功能
headlines.summary: 《智能网联汽车 自动驾驶系统安全要求》强制性国家标准正式发布。拟于2027年7月1日起正式实施。其中提到，该标准立足我国产业发展与行业监管实际需求，兼顾技术可行性、产业适配性与落地实操性，构建了维度完整、要求清晰、适配国情的安全要求体系。规范人机交互与用户告知要求，防范误用滥用风险。标准要求自动驾驶系统的激活和退出过程应安全，并明确就绪、激活、退出等状态信息及信号的提示规范。对于L3级自动驾驶系统还应具备驾驶人接管能力监测功能。

headlines.title_en: MIIT: L3 autonomous driving systems should have driver takeover capability monitoring functions
headlines.summary_en: The mandatory national standard for safety requirements of autonomous driving systems for intelligent connected vehicles has been officially released, set to take effect on July 1, 2027. The standard, based on China's industrial development and regulatory needs, balances technical feasibility, industrial adaptability, and practical application, establishing a comprehensive safety requirement framework. It regulates human-machine interaction and user notification requirements to prevent misuse and abuse risks. The standard requires safe activation and exit processes for autonomous driving systems, with clear notification specifications for status information and signals such as ready, activated, and exited states. For L3-level systems, driver takeover capability monitoring is also required.

headlines.title_en: Huaan Securities: Accumulated buyback of 11.2384 million shares, transaction amount 84.1679 million yuan
headlines.summary_en: Huaan Securities announced that it previously approved a share repurchase plan with funds of no less than RMB 100 million (inclusive) and no more than RMB 200 million (inclusive), a repurchase price cap of RMB 14.9/share, and a repurchase period of 3 months. As of July 31, 2026, the company had cumulatively repurchased 11.2384 million shares via centralized bidding, accounting for 0.22% of total share capital, with a lowest purchase price of RMB 7.37/share and highest of RMB 7.76/share, and cumulative transaction amount of RMB 84.1679 million (excluding fees).

headlines.title: 华润双鹤：合作方以3000万美元回购八氟丙烷脂质微球注射液相关权益
headlines.summary: 华润双鹤公告，公司于2026年6月16日与兰索斯签署《回购协议》，由兰索斯以总价款3000万美元回购DEFINITY 在中国境内的所有权益，款项分三期支付。截至本公告披露日，公司已完成第一期过渡工作，并收到回购款1500万美元（约合人民币1.01亿元）。DEFINITY 自获得《药品注册证书》至今未形成市场销售，本次回购不会对公司当期经营业绩产生重大影响。

headlines.title_en: China Resources Shuanghe: Partner buys back rights to perfluoropropane lipid microsphere injection for $30 million
headlines.summary_en: China Resources Double Crane announced that on June 16, 2026, it signed a repurchase agreement with Lantheus, under which Lantheus will repurchase all rights to DEFINITY in China for a total of $30 million, payable in three installments. As of the announcement date, the company has completed the first phase of transition work and received a repurchase payment of $15 million (approximately RMB 101 million). Since DEFINITY received its drug registration certificate, it has not generated market sales, and this repurchase will not have a material impact on the company's current operating results.

headlines.title_en: Chint Power: Cumulatively repurchased 5.9811 million shares, total transaction amount approximately 128 million yuan
headlines.summary_en: Chint Power Systems announced that on June 30, 2026, it approved a share repurchase plan to buy back A-shares through centralized bidding using自有 or self-raised funds for an employee stock ownership plan, with a repurchase price cap of RMB 35/share and total funds of no less than RMB 150 million and no more than RMB 250 million. As of July 31, 2026, the company had cumulatively repurchased 5.9811 million shares via a dedicated repurchase account, about 1.66% of total share capital, with a highest execution price of RMB 22.43/share, lowest of RMB 20.11/share, and total transaction amount of about RMB 128 million (excluding fees).

headlines.summary: 亚太药业公告，公司于2026年7月29日召开董事会审议通过回购方案，拟使用自有资金及自筹资金以集中竞价交易方式回购公司部分股份，用于实施股权激励或者员工持股计划。本次回购资金总额不低于人民币1000万元（含）且不超过人民币2000万元（含），回购价格不超过人民币7元/股（含），回购期限为自董事会审议通过本次回购方案之日起不超过12个月。截至2026年7月31日，公司尚未实施本次股份回购。

headlines.title_en: Yatai Pharma: Buyback plan approved, no repurchase implemented as of July 31, 2026
headlines.summary_en: Yatai Pharmaceutical announced that on July 29, 2026, its board approved a share repurchase plan to buy back shares via centralized bidding using自有 or self-raised funds for equity incentives or an employee stock ownership plan. The total repurchase funds will be no less than RMB 10 million (inclusive) and no more than RMB 20 million (inclusive), with a repurchase price cap of RMB 7/share (inclusive), and a repurchase period of no more than 12 months from board approval. As of July 31, 2026, the company has not yet implemented the repurchase.

headlines.title: 达仁堂：控股股东一致行动人增持72.42万股S股实施完成
headlines.summary: 达仁堂公告，控股股东医药集团之一致行动人津药国际有限公司于2026年2月披露增持计划，拟以不高于4美元/股价格增持公司S股，金额区间为不低于人民币1430万元且不超过人民币2859万元。截至2026年8月3日增持期限届满，实际增持金额209.62万美元（约合人民币14,305,902.11元），增持72.42万股，均价2.89美元/股，占总股本0.094%。增持后合计持股3.32亿股，比例由42.997%增至43.091%。

headlines.title_en: Daren Tang: Controlling shareholder's concerted action person completed increase of 724,200 S-shares
headlines.summary_en: Da Ren Tang announced that Jin Yao International, a concert party of controlling shareholder Pharmaceutical Group, disclosed an increase plan in February 2026 to buy S-shares at a price no higher than $4/share, with an amount ranging from no less than RMB 14.3 million to no more than RMB 28.59 million. As of August 3, 2026, the increase period ended, with actual purchases of $2.0962 million (approximately RMB 14,305,902.11), totaling 724,200 shares at an average price of $2.89/share, representing 0.094% of total share capital. After the increase, total holdings are 332 million shares, with the ratio rising from 42.997% to 43.091%.
